title: ModernisationAnchors
description: The places of the project a modernisation can attach to, one ranked list per anchor type, with the counted evidence every anchor rests on and the modernisation patterns that fit it

reasoning.description: Overall reasoning: how the anchors were derived from the counted evidence and the context map, and what the analysis could not see

anchors.description: One entry per anchor, of every anchor type whose input is present

anchorType.description: The kind of place the anchor points at

module.description: The module the anchor belongs to, empty when the anchor belongs to the project rather than to one module

element.description: The class, interface or thing the anchor points at, empty for an anchor type that has no element

evidence.description: The counted evidence the anchor rests on, every entry naming the analysis that counted it

rank.description: The rank of the anchor among the anchors of its type in this project, 1 being the anchor that rests on the strongest evidence

candidatePatterns.description: The modernisation patterns of the catalogue that fit the anchor, empty when no pattern of the catalogue fits it

reasoning.description: Why the anchor was read as it was, and for every candidate pattern what would make it the wrong choice

absentTypes.description: One entry per anchor type whose input analysis did not run, with the reason

anchorType.description: The anchor type that is absent

reason.description: Why the anchor type is absent, for example that the context map did not run
